articles.title: Vietnam proposes pact with India to protect classified information
articles.summary: Vietnam has proposed an agreement with India to exchange and protect classified information, alongside strengthening real-time strategic intelligence sharing. This initiative aims to deepen bilateral defence cooperation and enhance mutual security, reflecting growing strategic alignment between the two nations, particularly in the Indo-Pacific region.

articles.title: P.E.I. Premier Rob Lantz facing pressure to step down
articles.summary: Members of Prince Edward Island's Progressive Conservative Party have launched a formal petition, demanding a leadership vote for Premier Rob Lantz. This action signifies significant internal dissent within the party concerning Lantz's leadership, despite his recent assumption of the premier's office. Such challenges are integral to parliamentary democracies, showcasing the constant scrutiny and accountability faced by political leaders.
